sections.section: RULE - Balochistan Public Health Engineering Department Engineers (Civil Electrical and Mechanical) (B-16 and Above) Service Rules 1989
sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC HEALTH ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT, ENGINEERS (CIVIL,
ELECTRICAL AND MECHANICAL) (B-16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1989
BALOCHISTAN PUBLIC HEALTH ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT, ENGINEERS (CIVIL, ELECTRICAL
AND MECHANICAL) (B-16 AND ABOVE) SERVICE RULES, 1989
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 18th November, 2013]
No.S.O.(R-II)(20)1/2013-S&GAD/1739-88,
dated 18-11-2013.---In exercise of the powers
conferred by Section 25 of the Balochistan Civil Servants Act, 1974 (Act No. IX
of 1974), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following
amendments in the Balochistan Public Health Engineering Department, Engineers
(Civil, Electrical and Mechanical) (B-16 and above) Service Rules, 1989,
namely:--
In the
aforesaid rules,--
(1) in
recital, the parenthesis with the words and a comma "(Civil, Electrical
and Mechanical)", appearing after the word "Engineers" shall be
omitted;
(2) in rule
1, in sub-rule (1), the parentheses with the words and a comma "(Civil,
Electrical and Mechanical)", appearing after the word
"Engineers" shall be omitted;
(3) in the
Appendix, against Serial No.4, in column No.4, for clauses (b) and (c), the
following shall be substituted.
"(b) 10%
by promotion from amongst the members of the Service holding the post of
Sub-Engineer (BPS-11) with Bachelor's of Engineering prior to induction in the
Service, having at least seven (7) years' service as such, on seniority cum
fitness basis;
(c) 10% by
promotion from amongst the members of the Service holding the post of
Sub-Engineer (BPS-11) acquiring the Bachelor's of Engineering during the
Service, having at leas seven (7) years', service as such, on seniority cum
fitness basis;"
